[[Then and Now, Here and There]] | type = Primary }} [[The Missing Vanguard]] provides overview for the [[Ebon Vanguard]] story arc. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the [[Charr Homelands|Charr homelands]]. * Speak to [[Gwen]] in the [[Hall of Monuments]]. * Travel to [[Longeye's Ledge]] and search for clues about the Vanguard. ([[Against the Charr]]) * Free [[Pyre Fierceshot|Pyre]]'s warband and gain their aid. ([[Warband of Brothers]]) * Free the remaining Ebon Vanguard from the stronghold of [[Hierophant Burntsoul]]. ([[Assault on the Stronghold]]) * See [[Captain Langmar]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 10,000 [[Experience]] * 1,000 [[Vanguard reputation point]]s * [[Monumental Tapestry]] ==Walkthrough== {{section-stub}} Travel to [[Longeye's Ledge]], and speak to [[Olfun Longeye]]. Then follow the quest chain which starts with [[Search for the Ebon Vanguard]]. See the walkthroughs for the individual quests in the chain for further details. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Gwen : ''Ally with the Ebon Vanguard to fight the Destroyers.'' ===Intermediate dialogue=== '''Gwen''' : ''Thank the gods someone has finally come to help. The Ebon Vanguard has gone missing. Captain Langmar and the bulk of the Ebon Vanguard planned to pass through Longeye's Ledge to the east to raid into Charr territory. However, they are extremely overdue. I swear to Lyssa that if those inhuman beasts have harmed Captain Langmar, I will make them all pay!'' '''[[Olfun Longeye]]''' (located in Longeye's Ledge) : ''What's that? The Ebon Vanguard? That rag-tag bunch of humans passed through here not too long ago, muttering something about fighting Charr. I've got no problem with that just so long as they don't do it here. : ''I heard some fighting downhill a few nights ago southeast of here. From what I heard, it was a large battle. Keep your eyes open; it's likely you'll find some gear and weapons you can scavenge. If you find a nice axe, let me know.'' :: {{yes}} ''Thank you for the information. We'll focus our search to the southeast, and keep our eyes open.'' (Accepting updates '''The Missing Vanguard''', and adds '''Search for the Ebon Vanguard'''.) :: {{no|ingame}} ''I think we'll make camp here for a while. You have a nice view.'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Captain Langmar : ''Thank you for rescuing us, . Gwen told me that you went through on our behalf. It seems you and Gwen had quite the adventure. Rest assured, you may count on the Ebon Vanguard to aid you in the future.'' ==Notes== * Upon completion of the quest, you will be under the effect of [[Call of the Eye]] the next time you enter a non-[[outpost]] instance.
